title: I made a build visualizer to understand Bun's compile times
summary: A developer created a build visualizer tool to analyze and understand Bun's compile times, helping identify performance bottlenecks in build processes through visual representation of timing data.
problem_solved: Helps developers debug and understand slow build times in Bun by providing visual insights into compilation performance.
why_valuable: Enables developers to identify build bottlenecks and optimize their development workflow through intuitive visual analysis of compile times.
